facts.fact: Algérie Zoom reports the Direction Générale du Domaine National generalised the Amlak system, with a central national database for cadastre and land conservation, on 11 January 2026.
Algérie Zoom reports the generalisation of Amlak covers all local directions of cadastre, land conservation and state property, without exception.

note: The electronic land booklet is not yet launched, so nothing online is stated.
